name: [R1] Server-zone host contacting an external LLM API
description: Outbound to an external LLM API from a server/production host. Autonomous AI-agent harnesses need continuous LLM inference; egress from a host with no approved LLM use is high-signal. Tune labels.src_zone and the domain allowlist to your environment.
query: destination.domain:("api.openai.com" or "api.anthropic.com" or "api.openrouter.ai" or "openrouter.ai" or "api.deepseek.com") and labels.src_zone:("server" or "production" or "dmz")
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Hosts with an approved LLM integration — allowlist them.

name: [R2] Privileged / raw-socket / host-network container started
description: Container started privileged, on the host network, or with NET_RAW/NET_ADMIN — consistent with Cairn/Strix worker sandboxes. Correlate with unknown image names. Field names vary by data source (Falco, auditbeat, k8s audit); adjust to your mapping.
query: event.category:"container" and (container.security_context.privileged:true or process.args:("--privileged" or "--net=host" or "--network=host") or process.args:("NET_RAW" or "NET_ADMIN" or "cap_net_raw" or "cap_net_admin"))
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Legitimate network tooling / CNI / monitoring agents — allowlist images.

name: [R3] Admin/sensitive path enumeration burst (recon)
description: A single source produced a burst of 4xx responses against admin/sensitive endpoints — reconnaissance (Strix-style). Threshold rule: tune the count to your baseline and allowlist approved scanner source IPs.
query: http.response.status_code:(401 or 403 or 404) and url.path:(*admin* or *wp-login* or *phpmyadmin* or *manager\/html* or *\/console*)
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Authorized vulnerability scanners / monitoring — allowlist their source IPs.

name: [R4] Server-zone host contacting a messaging API (possible C2)
description: Outbound to a messaging platform API (Telegram/Discord/Slack/Signal) from a server/production host. Hermes-style orchestration can use messaging as a C2/report channel. Tune labels.src_zone and allowlist approved ChatOps integrations.
query: destination.domain:("api.telegram.org" or "discord.com" or "discordapp.com" or "slack.com" or "hooks.slack.com") and labels.src_zone:("server" or "production" or "dmz")
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Approved alerting/ChatOps integrations — allowlist these hosts/destinations.

name: [R5] New cron/systemd persistence created
description: Creation/modification of cron entries or systemd timer/service units — used by autonomous agents (Hermes-style) to persist scheduled automation. Correlate the creating process lineage with other stages.
query: event.category:"file" and event.type:("creation" or "change") and file.path:("/etc/crontab" or /etc/cron.* or /var/spool/cron/* or /etc/systemd/system/*)
author: ai-agent-attack-defense

name: [R6] Agent chain: recon tool then another tool under one parent (EQL)
description: Representative single-index correlation (EQL sequence): the same parent process runs a recon tool and then a different offensive tool within a few minutes — the fast, chained behavior of an autonomous agent. True cross-index correlation (R1 egress + R2 container + R7 tooling) is best built with Elastic's rule-on-rule / alert correlation; see this folder's README.
query:
sequence by process.parent.entity_id with maxspan=5m
  [process where event.type == "start" and process.name == "nmap"]
  [process where event.type == "start" and process.name in ("ffuf", "gobuster", "nikto", "sqlmap", "hydra", "nuclei", "wpscan", "msfconsole")]
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Authorized scanning pipelines — allowlist the orchestrator process/host.

name: [R7] Rapid multi-tool security tooling execution by one parent
description: One parent process spawning many DISTINCT security tools in a short window — the behavioral core of autonomous AI pentest agents (E2E agents, and MCP frameworks orchestrating 150+ tools). Persists even with a LOCAL LLM and no egress (R1). Threshold rule keyed on process.parent.entity_id with a cardinality floor on process.name; tune the cardinality value to your baseline.
query: process.name:("nmap" or "ffuf" or "gobuster" or "nikto" or "sqlmap" or "hydra" or "nuclei" or "wpscan" or "msfconsole" or "medusa" or "enum4linux")
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Authorized scanning pipelines / scheduled security scans — allowlist the orchestrator.
A human pentester working fast — correlate with authorization/scope.
